subject: The Södra Långgatan front (numbers 49-59) of the district volume 91846978: the cream hotel range with its gabled middle and arcade, the ochre-panelled range, the blue gabled house, the grey roughcast house and the salmon corner range with its front gable.
author: Claude (Anthropic), 2026-09-27
fixed_during_the_pass: the ochre panels first covered the second window of each pair; now cut at every opening
the salmon ground floor and the cream band hid the ground-floor windows and the entrance; now coats cut at the openings
the salmon front gable: the cornice ran across its foot; it now rises from the wall face
the dry-render region filter hid this block (it lies east of all earlier passes)
